name: Bean rust
symptoms: Small white or pale yellow spots on leaves Orange, brown or rust-colored pustules on leaf underside Powdery spores released from pustules Yellowing around lesions Severely infected leaves dry and fall early Occasional pustules on stems and pods
description: Bean rust is a fungal disease that affects bean leaves, stems and sometimes pods. It produces rust-colored pustules on leaf surfaces that reduce photosynthesis and can cause early leaf drop and yield loss.
management: Plant resistant bean varieties Rotate crops with non-host plants Remove infected crop residues Improve plant spacing for airflow Monitor fields early during the growing season
prevention: Use certified disease-free seeds Avoid dense planting Remove infected plant debris after harvest Use resistant cultivars Monitor crops during humid weather
